punchline: For $60, Ben Goldacre made his dead cat a certified professional.
thirty_sec: Gillian McKeith's CV listed membership of the American Association of Nutritional Consultants. Ben Goldacre paid the same association $60 and got a certificate for his cat Hettie, who had died a year earlier. No exam, no checks. Later a reader of his site complained to the ASA about McKeith calling herself 'Dr'. According to Goldacre, she agreed to drop the title from her advertising before the ASA published its ruling.
